data.body: The fsck --repair-snapshots rebuild path is now fixed (bug valiant-supreme-erin, Gerrit 3308, merged as e0bfa4e5154659b70415fe0dcaf72d9f6fd8af2b; MCP autodeploy reports mcp-deployed-sha = e0bfa4e5154 as of 2026-11-04 10:08 PST). Under the configured positive compaction horizon, the rebuilt SNAPSHOT now sits just after the newest raw event it absorbs instead of at the repair host's clock, so an event written on another clone shortly before the repair, not yet fetched, replays after the merge rather than becoming an ORPHAN_EVENT. Run the repair from a build at or after e0bfa4e5154: the global ~/.local/bin/rebar is an older build without this fix.
